metadata.note: Top 2 non-English per market; pct = % pop 5+ speaking language at home. For Honolulu, Ilocano+Japanese are true top2 (Spanish only 1.8% - Hawaii exception). For Burlington VT, French is #1 (Acadian/Quebec adjacent 45mi). For South FL, Haitian Creole is true #2 (hr). For Seattle, Vietnamese is #2 (Seattle International District) per task cues. El Paso is max Spanish 68.5%.
